scope: One bounded F01 advisory: presentation candidates for exactly the 290 supplied directory records. Not a runtime registry, translation release, route admission, access change or global navigation mapping.

metadata.status: candidate audit only; not a runtime registry or route admission

authorityAndApplication.registryAndExportOwner: F03 and the incumbent exporter/domain owners retain authority.
authorityAndApplication.soleWriter: The root F01 owner integrates this advisory; no second F01 writer/session is created.
authorityAndApplication.applicationOrder: Existing route membership, audience and access rules run first. A reviewed presentation overlay may apply only to already eligible exact IDs.
authorityAndApplication.accessAndPayloadTier: Every original kind and payloadTier is preserved. Unknown stays unknown. Titles such as Free, Live or Coming Soon do not establish access, freshness or lifecycle.
authorityAndApplication.entityAndDataBoundary: No issuer identity, listing resolution, availability, entitlement, data coverage, clock, signal quality, strategy risk or performance is inferred.
authorityAndApplication.translationBoundary: Every new EN/ZH label is a proposal. An English source string in the zh field is retained where purpose is unclear; it is not represented as a completed translation.
authorityAndApplication.uncertaintyRule: NEEDS_OWNER_REVIEW keeps both original labels exactly. Keep the baseline presentation by default, including its group; even a topic grouping/market qualifier suggested for that record remains held.
authorityAndApplication.marketRule: A qualifier uses only an explicit country/region token in the actual href or an existing regional group. Do not assign a default US/global region; opaque cn/cnmm/cm codes are not expanded.
authorityAndApplication.aliasRule: A small literal set from source name, path or question. Only extension removal and path-separator-to-space rendering are allowed transformations. No inferred synonyms or entity expansions.
authorityAndApplication.countRule: retain/rename compare both label strings exactly. category-change compares proposed category ID with the original group string; it includes the explicit change from nav-placement groups to browse-topic categories, not a deployed change. Needs-review overlaps these counts.
authorityAndApplication.productVerification: NOT_RUN; structural/data-integrity checks below are not product tests or independent acceptance.

categories.rationale: Named application workspaces; this browse category is not a global active-navigation mapping.
Country/region destinations and market heatmaps named by the baseline.
Stock dashboards, stock-labelled pages and dossiers; no issuer/listing identity is inferred.
Explicit macro topics, cycles and policy/reference subjects.
Explicit sector, subsector, theme and thematic-basket subjects.
The separately retained Options, Options & Market Structure, Options Screener and Futures destinations.
The source-labelled bonds, commodities, forex, crypto and reserves destinations.
Source-labelled research, analysis and intelligence subjects without an inferred geographic default.
Literal Fund-prefixed records and Fund Flows; no legal entity, fund classification or issuer identity is certified.
Literal strategy-labelled records; names do not establish mechanism, risk, performance or availability.
Explicit reports and the named Morning Edition; publication dates are not inferred from filename fragments.
Explicit news destinations; no freshness or coverage claim.
Named alerts, Monitor and the existing Winner Health label; no delivery or signal-quality claim.
Literal portfolio/watchlist wording; their different object semantics remain with domain owners.
The existing Free Tools and Scripts names; the word Free does not override access rules.
Explicit product descriptions, About, pricing and the product introduction/start destinations.
Help, support, glossary, methodology and learning names; repeated Learn routes remain separate.
Existing legal notices and Unsubscribe; no action is performed by this grouping.
Retain the existing unclassified group when this audit does not establish a more useful purpose.

sectorIntelligence.rule: Retain Sector Intelligence/行业情报; distinguish explicit United States and China groups. Other sector pages gain no default region.

optionsFamily.rule: Four separate results: Options; Options & Market Structure; Options Screener; Futures. Show exact paths; retain independent IDs/kinds/payload tiers. Do not add query variants or fold one into another.

allocationChina.rule: Keep both exact routes, names and review holds; do not equate either with Narrative Rotation.

learnFamily.rule: Keep all three routes. Learn versus Learning Center is not evidence of redirects, retirement or equivalent audience.

disambiguation.collisionBehavior: Retain every eligible result. Qualifier and path aid choice; no deduplication by a translated label, normalized alias or shared breadcrumb.
